description: This file defines the ApplyLoanLockTasklet class, which is a Spring Batch tasklet responsible for applying locks to loan accounts in the context of a batch processing job. It manages transaction boundaries and retry logic for locking loans, integrating with services to retrieve and lock loans based on specific parameters.

classes.name: ApplyLoanLockTasklet
classes.description: A Spring Batch Tasklet that applies locks to loan accounts during batch processing, with retry logic and transaction management.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method invoked by Spring Batch to perform the lock application process, handling retries and error management.

methods.name: applyLocks
methods.description: Performs the locking of loans within a new transaction context.

methods.name: getInClauseParameterSizeLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the limit for the number of IDs in an IN clause from configuration.
